Package index

App creation

create_smew_app()
Preprocesses data and creates files for SMEW app

Introductory tabs

IntroPanel_AnnoTabUI() IntroPanel_AnnoTabServer()
Presents metabolite annotations in an interactive table
IntroPanel_OverviewTabUI() IntroPanel_OverviewTabServer()
Overviews the structure and features of the SMEW app
IntroPanel_SpatialVisTabUI() IntroPanel_SpatialVisTabServer()
Visualises peaks and metadata spatially across samples

Bulk-level tabs

BulkPanel_QCTabUI() BulkPanel_QCTabServer()
Visualises bulk-level quality control
BulkPanel_DATabUI() BulkPanel_DATabServer()
Performs differential intensity analysis
BulkPanel_DASummaryTabUI() BulkPanel_DASummaryTabServer()
Visualises bulk differential intensity results
BulkPanel_ORATabUI() BulkPanel_ORATabServer()
Performs pathway over-representation analysis
BulkPanel_GRNTabUI() BulkPanel_GRNTabServer()
Infers metabolite peak covariation networks
BulkPanel_MultiCompareTabUI() BulkPanel_MultiCompareTabServer()
Performs and visualises multi-group comparisons
BulkPanel_MultiGRNTabUI() BulkPanel_MultiGRNTabServer()
Infers multi-omics covariation networks

Region-level tabs

RegionPanel_DimRedTabUI() RegionPanel_DimRedTabServer()
Applies and visualises dimensionality reduction
RegionPanel_VotingTabUI() RegionPanel_VotingTabServer()
Creates and visualises regions of interest using a voting scheme across multiple peaks
RegionPanel_HistologyTabUI() RegionPanel_HistologyTabServer()
Allows users to manually select regions of interest, optionally using histology images
RegionPanel_SpatialClustersTabUI() RegionPanel_SpatialClustersTabServer()
Performs and visualises spatially-informed clustering per sample
RegionPanel_SpatialSmoothingTabUI() RegionPanel_SpatialSmoothingTabServer()
Spatially smooths and denoises cluster labels across neighbouring spots
RegionPanel_ComparisonTabUI() RegionPanel_ComparisonTabServer()
Compares multiple regions and/or clusters
RegionPanel_DATabUI() RegionPanel_DATabServer()
Performs and visualises region-based differential analysis
RegionPanel_RadialDistanceTabUI() RegionPanel_RadialDistanceTabServer()
Analyses and visualises relationships between molecular intensity and distance from a region of interest
RegionPanel_GRNTabUI() RegionPanel_GRNTabServer()
Infers and visualises region-based covariation networks

Pixel-level tabs

PixelPanel_EnrichmentTabUI() PixelPanel_EnrichmentTabServer()
Performs and visualises spatial pathway enrichment analysis
PixelPanel_SVMTabUI() PixelPanel_SVMTabServer()
Identifies modules of spatially variable and colocalised metabolite peaks
